WITH th AS (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(c."equipRef", b.equip_ref) AS equip_code FROM "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON c."COMM_ID" = t.comm_link LEFT JOIN "PowerBattery" b ON b."PWR_BATT_ID" = t.batt_link),
s AS (SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE" AS equipment_code, e."EquipType" AS equipment_type, ls."lifeSupportStat" AS life_support_status, ls."O2SupplyStat", ls."medEquipStat", ls."safetySysStat",
 0.7 * CASE WHEN o."OPER_status" = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - o."OPER_hours"::numeric / NULLIF(o."maintCycleHrs", 0)::numeric) WHEN o."OPER_status" = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - o."OPER_hours"::numeric / NULLIF(o."maintCycleHrs", 0)::numeric) ELSE 0 END
 + 0.3 * CASE th."insulationStat" WHEN 'Good' THEN 0.9 - th."heatLoss_kwh"::numeric / 10 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - th."heatLoss_kwh"::numeric / 10 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - th."heatLoss_kwh"::numeric / 10 END AS lssr
 FROM "Equipment" e JOIN "OperationMaintenance" o ON o."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE" JOIN th ON th.equip_code = e."EQUIP_CODE" JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
 WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Safety')
SELECT equipment_code, equipment_type, life_support_status, ROUND(lssr, 2) AS lssr,
 CASE WHEN lssr >= 0.8 THEN 'High Reliability' WHEN lssr >= 0.6 THEN 'Moderate Reliability' WHEN lssr < 0.6 THEN 'Low Reliability' END AS reliability_classification,
 jsonb_build_object('oxygen_status', "O2SupplyStat", 'medical_status', "medEquipStat", 'safety_system_status', "safetySysStat") AS support_systems_status
FROM s ORDER BY s.lssr DESC
note: Rows with NULL LSSR (missing heat loss or maintenance cycle) sort first under plain DESC.

WITH th AS (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(c."equipRef", b.equip_ref) AS equip_code FROM "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON c."COMM_ID" = t.comm_link LEFT JOIN "PowerBattery" b ON b."PWR_BATT_ID" = t.batt_link),
s AS (SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE", ce.cabin_env_snapshot->'hvac'->>'heater_state' AS heater_status, th."insulationStat" AS insulation_status, ls."emerLightStat" AS emergency_light_status,
 ((100 - w."structLoadPct")/100.0 * CASE WHEN w."snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR w."windSpeed_ms" > 20 THEN 0.5 WHEN w."snowLoad_kgm2" > 50 OR w."windSpeed_ms" > 10 THEN 0.8 ELSE 1.0 END) AS ssf
 FROM "Equipment" e LEFT JOIN "OperationMaintenance" o ON o."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE" LEFT JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" w ON w.opmaint_link = o."OP_MAINT_ID"
 LEFT JOIN "CabinEnvironment" ce ON ce."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE" LEFT JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE" LEFT JOIN th ON th.equip_code = e."EQUIP_CODE"
 WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Shelter')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS extreme_weather_ready_shelters FROM s
WHERE ssf > 0.7 AND heater_status <> 'Off' AND insulation_status <> 'Good' AND emergency_light_status IN ('On', 'Testing')
note: EWRS as defined (insulation != Good). No shelter reaches SSF > 0.7, so the count is 0.

SELECT c."CHASSIS_ID" AS chassis_registry_id,
 (1 - ((c.ground_vehicle_status->'brake_system'->>'pad_wear_pct')::numeric + (c.ground_vehicle_status->'tracks'->>'wear_pct')::numeric) / 200)
 * (split_part(c.ground_vehicle_status->'vehicle_motion'->>'speed_kmh', ' ', 1)::numeric / 50)
 * ((ef.engine_fluids_snapshot->'engine_core'->>'load_pct')::numeric / 100) AS vpc
FROM "ChassisAndVehicle" c LEFT JOIN "EngineAndFluids" ef ON ef."ENGINE_ID" = c.engine_link
note: speed_kmh is stored as text with an "m/s" suffix; values have one decimal and max 60.0, so treated as km/h numbers with a mislabelled unit (no conversion).

SELECT o."OP_MAINT_ID" AS registry_id, o."OPER_hours" AS operation_hours, o."maintCycleHrs" AS maintenance_cycle_hours, o."OPER_status" AS operational_status,
 CASE WHEN o."OPER_status" = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - o."OPER_hours"::numeric / NULLIF(o."maintCycleHrs", 0)::numeric)
      WHEN o."OPER_status" = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - o."OPER_hours"::numeric / NULLIF(o."maintCycleHrs", 0)::numeric)
      ELSE 0 END AS ors
FROM "OperationMaintenance" o

WITH th AS (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(c."equipRef", b.equip_ref) AS equip_code FROM "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON c."COMM_ID" = t.comm_link LEFT JOIN "PowerBattery" b ON b."PWR_BATT_ID" = t.batt_link),
s AS (SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE" AS equipment_code, e."EquipType" AS equipment_type, ce.cabin_env_snapshot->'hvac'->>'heater_state' AS heater_status, th."insulationStat" AS insulation_status, ls."emerLightStat" AS emergency_light_status,
 ((100 - w."structLoadPct")/100.0 * CASE WHEN w."snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR w."windSpeed_ms" > 20 THEN 0.5 WHEN w."snowLoad_kgm2" > 50 OR w."windSpeed_ms" > 10 THEN 0.8 ELSE 1.0 END) AS ssf
 FROM "Equipment" e JOIN "OperationMaintenance" o ON o."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE" JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" w ON w.opmaint_link = o."OP_MAINT_ID"
 LEFT JOIN "CabinEnvironment" ce ON ce."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE" LEFT JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE" LEFT JOIN th ON th.equip_code = e."EQUIP_CODE")
SELECT equipment_code, equipment_type, heater_status, insulation_status, emergency_light_status, ROUND(ssf::numeric, 2) AS structural_safety_factor,
 CASE WHEN ssf > 0.7 AND heater_status <> 'Off' AND insulation_status <> 'Poor' AND emergency_light_status IN ('On','Testing') THEN 'Extreme Weather Ready' ELSE 'Not Ready' END AS extreme_weather_readiness_status
FROM s

WITH base AS (SELECT c.loc_link AS station_name, c."equipRef",
  CASE c.antenna_stat WHEN 'Error' THEN 0 WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5 WHEN 'Normal' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END * (1 - c."netLatency_ms"::numeric / 1000) AS cri,
  c."radioSignal_dBm"::numeric AS radio, c."netLatency_ms"::numeric AS latency
 FROM "Communication" c
 WHERE c.antenna_stat IS NOT NULL AND c."netLatency_ms" IS NOT NULL AND c."radioSignal_dBm" IS NOT NULL),
m AS (SELECT *, cri * (1 + 0.2 * radio / 100) * (1 - 0.01 * (1000 - latency)) AS bscsi FROM base),
g AS (SELECT l."STATION_name" AS station_name, AVG(m.cri) AS avg_cri, AVG(m.bscsi) AS avg_bscsi, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m."equipRef", ', ' ORDER BY m."equipRef") AS equipment_list
 FROM m JOIN "Location" l ON l."STATION_name" = m.station_name GROUP BY l."STATION_name")
SELECT station_name, ROUND(avg_cri, 2) AS avg_cri, ROUND(avg_bscsi, 2) AS avg_bscsi, equipment_list
FROM g
WHERE NOT (avg_cri > 0.8 AND avg_bscsi > 0.85) AND NOT (avg_cri > 0.6 AND avg_bscsi > 0.7)
ORDER BY avg_bscsi ASC

WITH r AS (SELECT l."locType" AS location_type, l."STATION_name" AS station_name, c."equipRef",
  COALESCE(t."solarOutput_w", 0) AS solar, COALESCE(t."windOutput_w", 0) AS wind, COALESCE(t."fuelCellOutput_w", 0) AS fuel
 FROM "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t JOIN "Communication" c ON c."COMM_ID" = t.comm_link JOIN "Location" l ON l."STATION_name" = c.loc_link
 WHERE t."solarOutput_w" > 0 OR t."windOutput_w" > 0),
g AS (SELECT location_type, station_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "equipRef") AS equipment_count,
  SUM(solar + wind)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(fuel + solar + wind), 0)::numeric * 100 AS rec, SUM(solar + wind) AS total_renewable_output_w
 FROM r GROUP BY location_type, station_name)
SELECT location_type, station_name, equipment_count, ROUND(rec, 2) AS renewable_energy_contribution, ROUND(total_renewable_output_w::numeric, 2) AS total_renewable_output_w,
 CASE WHEN rec > 70 THEN 'Energy-Sustainable' WHEN rec > 50 THEN 'Moderately Sustainable' ELSE 'Low Sustainability' END AS energy_sustainability_class
FROM g ORDER BY rec DESC

WITH e AS (SELECT e."EquipType" AS equipment_type, e."EQUIP_CODE" AS equipment_code,
  ((t.type_indices->>'performance_score')::numeric + e."RELIAB_IDX"::numeric) / 2 * (1 - (t.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx')::numeric / 100) AS eer,
  (t.type_indices->>'safety_idx')::numeric AS safety_index
 FROM "Equipment" e JOIN "EquipmentType" t ON t."EquipType" = e."EquipType"),
r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_type ORDER BY eer DESC) AS efficiency_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_type ORDER BY safety_index DESC) AS safety_rank FROM e)
SELECT equipment_type, equipment_code, ROUND(eer, 2) AS eer, safety_index, efficiency_rank, safety_rank, ABS(efficiency_rank - safety_rank) AS rank_difference
FROM r ORDER BY r.equipment_type, r.eer DESC
note: Safety index, performance score and environmental impact exist only per equipment type (EquipmentType.type_indices), so safety rank ties within each type; ranks are partitioned by equipment type.

SELECT l."STATION_name" AS station_name, ww."waterQualityIdx" AS water_quality_index, ww."waterLevelPct" AS water_level_percent,
 CASE WHEN ww."waterQualityIdx" >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality' WHEN ww."waterQualityIdx" >= 71 THEN 'Good' WHEN ww."waterQualityIdx" >= 51 THEN 'Moderate'
      WHEN ww."waterQualityIdx" >= 26 THEN 'Poor' WHEN ww."waterQualityIdx" < 26 THEN 'Unsafe' END AS water_quality_classification
FROM "Location" l LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON c.loc_link = l."STATION_name" LEFT JOIN "WaterAndWaste" ww ON ww."equipRef" = c."equipRef"
ORDER BY l."STATION_name"

WITH w AS (SELECT l."STATION_name" AS station_name, l."locType" AS location_type, ww."waterQualityIdx"::numeric AS wqi,
  (ww."waterLevelPct"::numeric / 100) * (ww."waterQualityIdx"::numeric / 100) * (1 - ww."wasteTankPct"::numeric / 100) AS wrmi
 FROM "WaterAndWaste" ww JOIN "Communication" c ON c."equipRef" = ww."equipRef" JOIN "Location" l ON l."STATION_name" = c.loc_link),
g AS (SELECT station_name, location_type, AVG(wqi) AS avg_wqi, AVG(wrmi) AS avg_wrmi, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wrmi < 0.5) AS conservation_needed_count
 FROM w GROUP BY station_name, location_type)
SELECT station_name, location_type, ROUND(avg_wqi, 2) AS avg_water_quality_index, ROUND(avg_wrmi, 2) AS avg_wrmi, conservation_needed_count,
 CASE WHEN avg_wqi >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality' WHEN avg_wqi >= 71 THEN 'Good' WHEN avg_wqi >= 51 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN avg_wqi >= 26 THEN 'Poor' WHEN avg_wqi < 26 THEN 'Unsafe' END AS water_quality_classification,
 CASE WHEN avg_wrmi < 0.5 THEN 'Conservation Needed' WHEN avg_wrmi < 0.7 THEN 'Monitoring Advised' WHEN avg_wrmi >= 0.7 THEN 'Sustainable Management' END AS water_resource_management_status
FROM g ORDER BY avg_wrmi DESC, avg_wqi DESC
